Baits are collectibles that increase or decrease certain buffs while fishing. They are consumed per cast so each /fish with bait decreases bait count by one. The only way to not consume bait per trip is by buying bait efficiency upgrade, which gives 5% (uncompounded) chance of not consuming bait per trip. The maximum number of bait one can have is 1000000. There are 8 baits boosting different buffs in various magnitudes. Note that some baits decrease certain buffs and it is a normal phenomenon.

The main bait page is not navigable. I will detail /shop in another page.

Due to issues each separate bait has its own page here.

Command Usage[]

The common usage is /bait [selection]. If the selection parameter is empty the main bait page is shown. The selection parameter should have at most one space in between for it to be valid, and capitalization does not matter. The word "bait" in wise and magic can be neglected. If the selection parameter is a valid type of bait that you have obtained, the bot will change the type of bait to you. If the selection parameter is a valid type of pet that you don't have, the bot displays an error message stating that you have none of that bait. If the selection parameter is anything else, "invalid bait" will be displayed as an error message. If you type none in the selection parameter the bot will automatically deselect the bait for you such that you will no longer use a bait.
